<b>Pin Badge</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. The emblem of the [[Order of the Pinstress]], it reduces the charge time of [[Needle Strike]] by 40%.

== Usefulness ==
The charge time of [[Needle Strike]] is reduced by 40%, from 1.35 seconds to 0.8 seconds. This substantially improves the viability of Needle Strike in combat, allowing Hornet to perform stronger hits much more quickly.

Pin Badge pairs well with [[Crests]] that have exceptionally powerful charge attacks, such as the [[Wanderer Crest|Wanderer]], [[Witch Crest|Witch]] and [[Architect Crest|Architect]] Crests.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Pinstress]] after completing the <i>[[Fatal Resolve]]</i> Wish.
